destinations.tagline: Pristine Scuba Waters, Chhatrapati Shivaji Sea Fort & Authentic Malvani Soul
destinations.description: Sindhudurg and Tarkarli offer crystal-clear Arabian Sea waters, pristine white-sand virgin beaches, vibrant coral reefs for scuba diving, and the formidable 17th-century Sindhudurg Sea Fort. A sustainable, culturally rich alternative to crowded party beaches.

destinations.name: Pune
destinations.tagline: The Cultural Epicenter of Maharashtra: Peshwa Heritage, Misal Trails & Sahyadri Forts
destinations.description: Pune harmoniously blends Maratha and Peshwa imperial heritage, world-renowned street gastronomy, bustling traditional peths for handlooms, and rugged Sahyadri hill fort treks like Sinhagad and Rajgad.

itinerary.description: Ascend the Eiger Express gondola and historic cogwheel railway into the glacier mountain station. Walk through the Ice Palace.

itinerary.title: Lauterbrunnen Valley & Grindelwald First Cliff Walk
itinerary.description: Visit the fairytale valley of 72 waterfalls. Take cable car to Grindelwald First and walk the thrilling metal walkway suspended over abyss.

itinerary.title: Lake Brienz Cruise & Transfer to Lucerne
itinerary.description: Glide on turquoise glacial waters aboard a paddle steamer. Visit Giessbach Falls, then train to historic Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Mount Titlis 360° Revolving Cable Car & Glacier Cave
itinerary.description: Ride the world’s first revolving cable car to Mount Titlis summit. Walk across Europe’s highest suspension bridge.

itinerary.title: Lake Lucerne Panorama Cruise & Cheese Tasting
itinerary.description: Relax on a panoramic yacht cruise across Lake Lucerne with artisan Swiss cheese & wine tasting.

itinerary.title: Departure via Zurich Panoramic Train
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast overlooking Lake Lucerne before scenic train back to Zurich Airport for departure.
